definitions: A surname transferred from the place name.
A village and civil parish in West Suffolk district, Suffolk, England, previously in St Edmundsbury district .
The most commonly sold banana; one of the triploid (AAA) cultivars of Musa acuminata.
Alternative form of cavendish (“type of tobacco”).

blocks.text: Cavendish is an English toponymic surname, deriving from a placename in Suffolk.
Cavendish is a masculine given name which is borne by:

items: Cavendish Morton (actor) (1874–1939), British actor, photographer, and art director
Cavendish Morton (artist) (1911–2015), British painter and illustrator
